sources.note: Main website. Describes Healogics as nation's largest wound care provider, 600+ centers, 300K+ patients/year, 30-year history. Mentions WoundSuite technology and Wound Science Initiative database of 5M+ wounds.
About page. 3,000 employees, 4,000 affiliated physicians, 300 specialty physicians. 30-year history, nearly 4M wounds healed.

ONC certified EHR technology page. Lists i-heal 2.0 APIs (authentication, patient search, demographics, common data sets), FHIR g(10) documentation, EHI export documentation, real world testing plans/results, SVAP notice.

WoundSuite product page. Describes three components: i-heal (documentation manager), Clinical Optimization (process automation), Healogics Photo+ (wound measurement). Focused on reimbursement accuracy, productivity, and patient satisfaction.

Clinical Optimization module details. Features: strategic scheduling, productivity planning, pre-clinic huddles, intake/discharge, staff communication, physician/case manager collaboration, ICMG, MSR process. Based on six-sigma lean methodology.

Wound Care Centers page. Describes services including HBO, NPWT, total contact casting, cellular/tissue-based products. Interdisciplinary model including PT, OT, nutrition, infectious disease, diabetes education.
Inpatient services page. Describes WoundSuite for inpatient settings, staffing, supply management, WOCN training. Does not specifically mention i-heal by name for inpatient use.

Billing/coding resources. E&M documentation guidelines, CPT code selection tools for inpatient and outpatient codes, NCD for HBO therapy, modifier reference sheets. Suggests i-heal supports billing documentation workflows.

Physician communication about i-heal improvements. Confirms i-heal used for physician documentation, billing, compliance, and advanced modality features. Mentions MIPS certification, hard stops/warnings for documentation, planned workflow improvements, doubled resources for system performance.

June 2018 press release launching WoundSuite. Describes Clinical Optimization (one-click patient summary, medical surveillance) and Decision Support (mobile wound photography, planimetric measurement, pre/post-debridement, cloud-based HIPAA-compliant image upload).
2014 CD&R acquisition press release. $910M transaction, ~$300M revenue, ~2,000 employees at time of acquisition. Acquired from Metalmark Capital and Scale Venture Partners.
2015 Accelecare acquisition. Expanded network to nearly 600 centers.

Net Health partnership (2023). Healogics has used Net Health solutions since 2012. New agreement integrates Tissue Analytics (AI wound imaging platform) into Healogics sites. 630+ locations, 350K+ patients/year.
EHI export documentation PDF. Could not be read (binary PDF rendering issue). Would be the definitive source for exported data elements.
FHIR API documentation for g(10). Confirms HL7 FHIR US Core Implementation Guide STU 4.0.0 adoption for Patient and Population API Services.
HBO therapy page. Describes treatment process including vital signs, lung examination, ear examination. Confirms HBO is core service requiring clinical data tracking.
